Grouping uses the ordering table: one mode per orderable part number, with reach from the `xxM` length suffix. Shared electrical/interface values apply to all SKUs. `SO-QSFPDD-AOCxxM-4` is the family placeholder with no single reach, so it is omitted per the evidence rule. No penalties were supplied.
